added.summary: The rpg genre kit, for party RPGs and open-world games: RpgInventory, RpgEquipment, RpgJournal, RpgTracker, RpgDialogue, RpgParty, RpgTurnOrder, RpgWorldMap and RpgCompass. Each draws what the game passes as keyed collections and sends intents with row keys (choose, equip, track, travel…), from touch, keyboard and pad, with device prompts; it computes no rule. Install it with `og ui add rpg`; its parts are listed in its README and dressed by the fantasy pack.
